meme.note: Viral by email since 1996-97 (Wikipedia: viral status 1997-1998), so the meme itself is fine for 1998. The blurb mentions Ally McBeal: the baby's first episode, 'Cro-Magnon' (S1E12), aired January 5, 1998. Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ally_McBeal_season_1 (air date), https://www.tvline.com/2104160/internet-first-memes-dancing-baby-ally-mcbeal/ (first appearance in 'Cro-Magnon'). Drop the Ally McBeal clause and it can show from 01-01.

facts.text: The Winter Olympics open in Nagano, Japan (February 7).
Titanic wins 11 Oscars, tying the all-time record (March 23).
Windows 98 goes on sale (June 25).
Apple's translucent Bondi Blue iMac goes on sale (August 15).
Google is founded in a garage in Menlo Park, California (September 4).
John Glenn, 77, returns to space aboard the shuttle Discovery (October 29).

facts_note: Kept all 3 (Titanic, Windows 98, Google), dates confirmed. Added Nagano, iMac, John Glenn.

tech.note: Fits: launched October 2, 1998, the must-have toy of Christmas 1998 (resale price over $100).

meme.note: Page made in August 1997 (not 1998); word spread by email and blogs in February 1999 and Slashdot linked it on February 9, 1999; 60,000 views in four days by March. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hampster_Dance (the Slashdot link is its cited reference, dated February 9, 1999).

facts.text: Family Guy premieres on Fox right after the Super Bowl (January 31).
The Matrix hits cinemas with its 'bullet time' effect (March 31).
SpongeBob SquarePants premieres on Nickelodeon (May 1).
Napster launches and lets people swap MP3 music files (June 1).
A total solar eclipse sweeps across Europe (August 11).
Toy Story 2 opens in cinemas (November 24).

facts_note: Kept 3, reworded two future claims: The Matrix 'makes bullet time famous' and Napster 'music sharing explodes' (both came later); Napster dated June 1. Added Family Guy, the eclipse, Toy Story 2.

tech.note: Fits. Announced March 18, 1999; Nokia's press release: 'available in volume in the second quarter of 1999'. No shop date found, so on = end of Q2 (conservative).

meme.note: Baha Men single released July 26, 2000; the Seattle Mariners started playing it in June 2000; UK No. 2 and the fourth-biggest UK single of 2000. A song craze rather than a web meme, but it is the 2000 phenomenon. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Who_Let_the_Dogs_Out

facts.text: The dreaded Y2K bug is a no-show: only minor glitches (January 1).
The Sims is released: players run the lives of virtual people (February 4).
Scientists announce a first rough draft of the human genome (June 26).
Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire is published (July 8).
The Summer Olympics open in Sydney, Australia (September 15).
The first crew moves into the International Space Station (November 2).

facts_note: Kept 3 (Y2K, The Sims, ISS crew); The Sims 'becomes a smash hit' came later, reworded. Added the genome draft, Goblet of Fire, the Sydney Olympics.

tech.note: Fits. Japan March 4, 2000 (= on); North America October 26, Europe November 24.

meme.note: The phrase circulated as a GIF from 1999-2000; Bad_CRC's Flash video went up on Newgrounds on February 16, 2001 and spread fast. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/All_your_base_are_belong_to_us

facts.text: Wikipedia goes online (January 15).
Dennis Tito flies to the space station as the first space tourist (April 28).
Shrek opens in US cinemas (May 18).
Spirited Away opens in Japanese cinemas (July 20).
Windows XP (October 25) and the first Xbox (November 15) are released.
The first Harry Potter film opens in cinemas (November 16).

facts_note: Kept 3, dated: Windows XP October 25 and Xbox November 15 (on = 11-15), Harry Potter film November 16. Added Dennis Tito, Shrek, Spirited Away.

tech.note: Fits as the year's landmark gadget: announced October 23, on sale November 10, 2001. Late in the year; the Game Boy Advance (Japan March 21, elsewhere June) is the earlier 2001 alternative.

meme.note: Right meme for 2002: the Flash cartoon was posted to the OffTopic.com forums in early 2002 and to Newgrounds on March 21, 2002 (https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/peanut-butter-jelly-time; Wikipedia only says 'early 2002', https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buckwheat_Boyz). Blurb fix only: the banana dances, the Buckwheat Boyz sing. Image and source unchanged (the image is a PB&J sandwich photo, it loads).

replacement.title: Peanut Butter Jelly Time
replacement.blurb: A pixel banana dances to 'It's peanut butter jelly time!' in a Flash cartoon.

facts.text: Euro notes and coins go into circulation in 12 countries (January 1).
The Winter Olympics open in Salt Lake City (February 8).
Spider-Man is the first film to make $100 million in one weekend (May 5).
Brazil beats Germany to win a record fifth World Cup (June 30).
Kelly Clarkson wins the first season of American Idol (September 4).
The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers opens in cinemas (December 18).

facts_note: Kept 3, fixed: euro cash went into circulation January 1 (old currencies phased out by March); Spider-Man's record weekend was May 3-5; American Idol premiered June 11 and Clarkson won September 4. Added Salt Lake City, Brazil's fifth World Cup, The Two Towers.

tech.note: Fits: Nokia's first camera phone, much hyped, released June 26, 2002.

meme.note: Went live on B3ta.com on September 2, 2003. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Badgers_(animation)

facts.text: Apple unveils its own web browser, Safari (January 7).
Apple opens the iTunes Music Store: 99 cents a song (April 28).
Finding Nemo swims into cinemas (May 30).
Skype is released, with free voice calls over the internet (August 29).
Supersonic Concorde makes its last commercial flights (October 24).
The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King opens (December 17).

facts_note: Kept 3: Skype dated August 29; Finding Nemo 'the year's big animated hit' came later, reworded (US release May 30). Added Safari, Concorde's last flights, The Return of the King.

tech.note: Fits. Japan February 14, 2003 (= on); other regions in March.

meme.note: Uploaded to Newgrounds on December 6, 2004 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Numa_Numa); the big spread came in early 2005. Named in the brief, so it stays, but before 12-06 the 2004 card has no meme.

facts.text: NASA's rovers Spirit and Opportunity land on Mars (January 4 and 25).
Facebook launches at Harvard as 'TheFacebook' (February 4).
Gmail launches with a huge 1 GB inbox (April 1).
SpaceShipOne makes the first private human spaceflight (June 21).
Outsiders Greece win Euro 2004 in Portugal (July 4).
Mozilla releases Firefox 1.0 (November 9).

facts_note: Kept 3; the rovers are dated (Spirit January 4, Opportunity January 25, on = 01-25). Added SpaceShipOne, Greece at Euro 2004, Firefox 1.0.

tech.note: Changed from Motorola RAZR V3: the RAZR shipped only from September 2004 (Asia, Europe) and November 16 (US) and was the top US phone of 2005-2007. iPod mini: on sale February 20, 2004, often out of stock.

meme.note: The 'Leeroy!!' video was released on Warcraftmovies on May 11, 2005. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leeroy_Jenkins

facts.text: The Huygens probe lands on Saturn's moon Titan (January 14).
Google Maps launches (February 8).
YouTube's first video, 'Me at the zoo', is uploaded (April 23).
Star Wars: Episode III closes the prequel trilogy (May 19).
Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince is published (July 16).
Microsoft's Xbox 360 goes on sale in North America (November 22).

facts_note: Kept 3, dates confirmed. Added Huygens, Half-Blood Prince, Xbox 360.

tech.note: Changed from iPod nano (on sale only from September 7, 2005; keep it if you prefer). RAZR V3: out since late 2004 and the most popular US phone of 2005, so on = 01-01.

meme.note: Uploaded April 6, 2006; it first became YouTube's most-viewed video on May 19, 2006, which the blurb claims (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_most-viewed_YouTube_videos; upload date: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Judson_Laipply). For 04-06, drop the most-viewed claim from the blurb.

facts.text: NASA launches New Horizons on its way to Pluto (January 19).
The first tweet is sent: 'just setting up my twttr' (March 21).
Italy wins the World Cup in Berlin on penalties (July 9).
Pluto is reclassified as a dwarf planet (August 24).
Facebook opens to everyone aged 13 and over (September 26).
Google agrees to buy YouTube for $1.65 billion (October 9).

facts_note: Kept 3; the YouTube deal was announced October 9 and closed November 13, so 'agrees to buy'. Added New Horizons, Italy's World Cup, Facebook opening to everyone.

tech.note: Fits: North America November 19, 2006; most other regions in December.

meme.note: Cat macros existed since 2005-06, but lolcats 'did not become a sensation until early 2007' with I Can Has Cheezburger?, whose first post (the CHEEZBURGER cat) went up January 11, 2007; peak traffic May 2007. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lolcat

facts.text: Netflix starts streaming movies online (January 16).
Pixar's Ratatouille opens in US cinemas (June 29).
The New 7 Wonders of the World are announced in Lisbon (July 7).
Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows, the last book, is out (July 21).
Halo 3 makes $170 million on its first day (September 25).
Amazon releases the first Kindle e-reader (November 19).

facts_note: Kept 3; Netflix streaming started January 16. Added Ratatouille, New 7 Wonders, Halo 3.

tech.note: Fits: announced January 9, on sale in the US June 29, 2007.

meme.note: Started on 4chan on May 15, 2007 and spread within days; peak in 2008 (Anonymous protests in February, YouTube's April Fools' prank on April 1, Macy's parade in November). Already viral when 2008 began, so 01-01. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rickrolling

facts.text: Apple unveils the ultra-thin MacBook Air (January 15).
Iron Man kicks off the Marvel Cinematic Universe (May 2).
Apple's App Store opens with about 500 apps (July 10).
The Beijing Olympics open on 08/08/08 (August 8).
Google Chrome is released (September 2).
Spotify launches its music streaming service in Europe (October 7).

facts_note: Kept 3, dates confirmed. Added MacBook Air, the Beijing Olympics, Spotify.

tech.note: Fits: the 2008 netbook craze. First model on sale October 16, 2007 (Taiwan), so on = 01-01.

meme.note: Brad O'Farrell posted 'Play Him Off, Keyboard Cat' on February 2, 2009; BuzzFeed and Urlesque featured it on April 10, 2009 (first to call it a meme); mainstream in May (Ashton Kutcher tweet May 5, AP story May 22). 04-10 is the first date it was demonstrably viral. Sources: https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/keyboard-cat , https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Keyboard_Cat (February 2009, May 2009 coverage).

facts.text: Bitcoin's first block is mined (January 3).
Susan Boyle stuns Britain's Got Talent with 'I Dreamed a Dream' (April 11).
The first version of Minecraft appears online (May 17).
Usain Bolt runs 100 m in a record 9.58 seconds in Berlin (August 16).
Windows 7 goes on sale (October 22).
James Cameron's Avatar opens in 3D (December 18).

facts_note: Kept 3; Avatar 'smashes box-office records' came later (it passed Titanic in January 2010), reworded. Added Susan Boyle, Bolt's 9.58, Windows 7.

tech.note: Fits: best-selling pocket camcorder; Flip Ultra out September 12, 2007, Cisco bought Flip in March 2009. on = 01-01.

meme.note: Uploaded January 8, 2010; went viral after Jimmy Kimmel tweeted it on July 3, 2010. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Double_Rainbow_(viral_video). Blurb fix only: Paul Vasquez filmed it from his yard near Yosemite, he was not a hiker. Image and source unchanged.

replacement.title: Double Rainbow
replacement.blurb: A man near Yosemite films a double rainbow and asks 'What does it mean?' Millions watch.

facts.text: The Burj Khalifa opens in Dubai as the world's tallest building (January 4).
The Winter Olympics open in Vancouver, Canada (February 12).
Shakira's 'Waka Waka' is the sound of the World Cup in South Africa (June 11).
Toy Story 3 (June 18) and Inception (July 16) open in cinemas.
Instagram launches on the iPhone (October 6).
Microsoft's Kinect lets Xbox 360 players play with their body (November 4).

facts_note: Kept 3: Waka Waka dated to the World Cup start June 11; 'rule the summer box office' was a later claim, now both release dates. Added Burj Khalifa, Vancouver Olympics, Kinect.

tech.note: Fits: on sale in the US April 3, 2010.

meme.note: Chris Torres posted the GIF on April 2, 2011; the YouTube video 'Nyan Cat' went up on April 5, 2011. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nyan_Cat

facts.text: IBM's computer Watson beats two Jeopardy! champions (February 16).
Game of Thrones premieres on HBO (April 17).
Prince William and Kate Middleton marry in London (April 29).
The final Harry Potter film opens (July 15).
Atlantis lands and the Space Shuttle program ends (July 21).
Skyrim is released on 11/11/11.

facts_note: Kept 3, dates confirmed. Added Watson on Jeopardy!, Game of Thrones, the last Shuttle landing. Skipped Adele's 21: Rolling in the Deep is already the 2011 No. 1 song on the card.

tech.note: Fits: on sale October 14, 2011, with Siri. Earlier-year alternative: iPad 2 (March 11, 2011).
